hypothesis: Resolution, visibility and context completeness improve class evidence reliability beyond a matched ordinary evidence-only head.
stage: Small train-scene-held-out pilot permitted by candidate11, not official efficacy or novelty.
sample: Reuse exactly candidate9's256 fitting/128 head-held-out train images; no selection from candidate11 test-dev. Frozen detector historically trained on these train images.
inputs: 62 features per class action: original detection geometry/score, original/choice class, per-view class evidence,20 score-weighted observation context features. Context-blind head zeros last20 channels; same nominal architecture.
targets: Class-agnostic score-ordered IoU>=0.5 one-to-one train GT ownership. Select its class only when already supported by the prediction-only action menu; otherwise keep. Ignore boxes define training/evaluation masks only after all evidence features are generated.
training_rows: Every conflicting row(valid actions>=2) with frozen original score>=0.05; confidence-weighted masked cross entropy. No class balancing or result-dependent sampling.

recipe.selection: Final epoch only; seed1/2 only after seed0 passes.

inference: Only rows with original score>=0.05 may change class; best supported class probability must exceed original by>0.10. Same scores, coordinates, count and order. Frozen calibration is not refitted after label changes.
limits: Fixed confidence class-aware matching with diagnostic max individual ignored-box IoF>0.5 is not official AP/AR. Head seed repeats share one detector and the same scenes. Padding gives equal nominal parameters but inactive blind context weights. Existing detector/calibrator see train scenes historically.
budget: At most1920 frozen detector view forwards on384 train images, once; two small heads at seed0, four more only after a positive gate. No full detector training, no official evaluator until repeatable pilot signal.
